surface_verification.justification: Terminal links are a real-browser behavior (xterm link activation, new tab, Viewer pane switch, touch scroll vs tap); the jsdom unit tests use a fake buffer and cannot prove xterm's linkifier fires. Spec 106 drives the real client xterm, real pty and real session-file route through isolated-stack.mjs in Chromium, including a Pixel-5 touch emulation.
